description: Scrape public Skool communities, courses, and visible member lists. Browse the community directory, get details for specific communities, or list members from public communities.

category.description: Deprecated alias for categorySlug kept so saved tasks keep working. categorySlug takes precedence when both are set.
category.title: Category (legacy alias)

categorySlug.description: Browse one of Skool's nine directory categories, or all categories. Filtering by category also fills the category fields on each community.
categorySlug.title: Category (mode=discover)

communityType.description: Filter the directory by public or private communities.
communityType.title: Community type (mode=discover)

enrichDetails.description: Open each discovered community to add pricing, owner, rating, review and roster fields.
enrichDetails.title: Fetch full community details (mode=discover)

includeReviews.description: Add the latest public reviews (up to five) to each community record.
includeReviews.title: Include recent reviews

isFree.description: Deprecated alias for priceType=free kept so saved tasks keep working. priceType takes precedence when set.
isFree.title: Free communities only (legacy alias)

language.description: Filter the directory by the community's language.
language.title: Language (mode=discover)

maxItems.description: Maximum number of records to emit (communities or members combined).
maxItems.title: Max items

maxMembers.description: Only keep communities with at most this many members.
maxMembers.title: Maximum members (mode=discover)

maxMembersPerCommunity.description: Maximum public members to emit per community. Skool exposes about 30 rows per tab plus the admin and online tabs.
maxMembersPerCommunity.title: Max members per community (mode=getMembers)

memberScope.description: Which public member tab to read: the default members list, the online list, the admin list, or all three combined.
memberScope.title: Member tabs (mode=getMembers)

minMembers.description: Only keep communities with at least this many members.
minMembers.title: Minimum members (mode=discover)

mode.description: What to scrape: discover communities from the directory, get details for specific communities, or list visible members.
enumTitles: Get community details (by URL or slug)
mode.title: Mode

priceType.description: Filter communities by membership price: free, paid, or free trial.
priceType.title: Price (mode=discover)

searchQueries.description: Keywords to search the Skool directory for, e.g. ["ai automation", "fitness"]. Leave empty to browse the selected category and sort order.
searchQueries.title: Search keywords (mode=discover)

slugs.description: Community slugs from the Skool URL, e.g. ["the-skool-of-life", "buildwithskool"]. Alternative to startUrls.
slugs.title: Community slugs (mode=getCommunity / getMembers)

sortBy.description: Order the directory by trending or by all-time popularity. Legacy popular/new values are accepted.
sortBy.title: Sort by (mode=discover)

title: Skool Communities & Courses Scraper Input
